parameters.name: CurrentPowerMode
parameters.description: Specifies the current sleep/power-saving mode of the ZigBee device. {{enum}}

parameters.name: AvailablePowerSource
parameters.description: Specifies the power sources available on this ZigBee device. {{list}} {{enum}}

parameters.name: CurrentPowerSource
parameters.description: The current power source field specifies the current power source being utilized by the node. {{enum}}

parameters.name: CurrentPowerSourceLevel
parameters.description: Specifies the level of charge of the current power source. {{enum}}

object.description: The {{object}} object describes the power capabilities of the ZigBee device as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|section 2.3.2.4 Node Power Descriptor}}.
